plugins.readme_text: # 侧栏代码引用搜索工具（dsh-sidebar-editor） 在 DSH 右侧栏的文档面板里**彩色预览工作区代码文件**，并把**选中的行一键引用到对话框**。 可编辑与保存的能力仍在 bundle 里，但**默认关闭**（原因见下方「面板的形态：预览优先」）。 这是一个 DSH 插件 bundle（`dsh-sidebar-editor`），**免构建**：客户端半边是纯 classic script，宿主半边只注册一条路由。 ## 状态 预览、分类着色、行选、引用、右键菜单（含剪切/复制/粘贴/全选）、大文件降级、以及宿主保存路由**都已实现**； 其中编辑器与保存默认不启用。离线自检 `node E:\DSH\_tools\selfcheck-sidebar-editor.js` 覆盖 **300 项断言**（客户端）+ **29 项断言**（宿主路由）， 包含后缀覆盖契约、hook 顺序纪律、着色分类与注入防护、右键菜单、标准编辑项、三种引用形态、文件树行右键、拖选成范围、搜索面板、tab 条滚轮与自动揭露、 「出厂默认形态」、大文件降级边界、宿主路由的完整信封与全部失败码映射。 ## 它做了什么 - 注册文档预览实现 `dsh-sidebar-editor/code`，属于 `extension` 档。后缀的认领规则是： **内置「代码」渲染器认领的每一个后缀，我全都认领**，只排除被其他渲染器专门接管的那几个。 因为 `extension` 档排在 `builtin` 之前，**这些文件打开时默认就是编辑器**； 而内置「代码」渲染器仍然匹配同一个后缀，所以渲染器下拉里始终有它，随时可切回去看 Shiki 高亮。 这条规则同时保证了两件事：任何原本以只读代码视图打开的文件都不会"没有编辑器"， 且任何被我接管的文件都"有路可回"。 - 唯一的例外是刻意**不认领**其他内置渲染器已占用的后缀：`md`/`markdown`（Markdown 预览）、 `html`/`htm`（沙箱 HTML 预览）、`svg` 与位图（图片）、`pdf`、`xlsx`/`xls`/`csv`/`tsv`（表格）、 Office 文档 —— 认领它们会把这些文件的默认预览从用户手里抢走。 - 另外额外认领了十几个内置表里没有的文本后缀（`txt`、`astro`、`json5`、`sass`、`.gitignore`、 `.editorconfig`、`.npmrc`、`Cargo.lock` …）。这些文件我是唯一候选，所以**没有渲染器下拉**， 只能靠面板里的「只读」开关切换视图。自检里有一条断言把"超出内置表的后缀"限制在 20 个以内。 - 宿主半边注册一条精确 Fetch 路由 `POST /api/sidebarEditor/save`。 - 面板里没有任何 DSH 客户端包的 import：编辑器、行号槽、轻量高亮、地址解析全部自带， 颜色只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 与 `--shiki-token-*` 主题 token。 ### 面板能做什么 | 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | 预览 | 自带分类着色（注释 / 字符串 / 数字与字面量 / 关键字 / 函数名与定义 / 装饰器与类名 / 属性 / 标点 / markup 标签与属性），按行渲染，可点选行 | | 选行 | 点一行选中、`Shift+点击` 扩选，**鼠标拖选任意多行**也直接成为引用范围；`已选 L5-L9` 实时显示 | | 右键 | 面板内的右键菜单是插件自绘的，除三种引用外还带 **剪切 / 复制 / 粘贴 / 全选**（预览形态只保留引用与「复制」）；右键某行会先把该行选为范围 | | 引用选中行 | 把 `@路径 L10-L20` 插入到对话输入框 | | 引用整个文件 | 工具条按钮与菜单项，插 `@路径`（不带行号） | | 引用所在目录 | 菜单项，插 `@目录/`（带尾斜杠）；文件就在工作区根目录时该项不出现 | | **文件树右键** | 直接在最右侧**文件树的行**上右键 → 「引用整个文件」/「引用这个目录」，外加「复制绝对路径」。不要求先打开面板 | | **文件面板搜索框** | 文件树的工具栏里（路径栏那一排的**最左**）多一个搜索框：输入即按名字匹配工作区文件（**文件与文件夹都匹配**），结果浮层列出「名字 + 所在目录」。点**文件**结果 → **先在文件树里展开到它、滚动进视野、高亮那一行，然后才打开该文件**；点**文件夹**结果 → 不打开任何东西，只在树里展开定位并高亮（已经展开的不再收起）。Esc 或点外面收起 | | **文件内查找** | 打开文件后，工具条上的「查找」按钮（面板有焦点时 Ctrl+F）：在当前文件内按行匹配、命中行加底色、1/N 行 计数、↑↓/Enter 逐个跳（到头回绕），跳到的行同时成为选中行，可直接引用 | | **搜索快捷键** | `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P` 打开「文件」tab 并聚焦搜索框（命令 `sidebarEditor.filesearch`）。键位在**设置 → 快捷键**（或 `Mod+/`）里改、清除、恢复默认，插件不持有键位副本 | | **条带滚动** | 右侧边栏 tab 开多了时：滚轮停在 tab 条上即左右滚动；新激活的 tab 会自动滚进视野（原来它只会停在视野外） | | 大文件 | 超过 4000 行时关闭着色只出纯文本，并在工具条上说明；行仍然可选可引用 | | 字号 | 工具条右侧的 `A− / A+` 步进器调**代码字号**，10–22px，默认 13px，选择会被记住 | | 编辑（默认关闭） | `

# 自动开发调度器（dsh-orchestrator 系列）

> DSH agent preset 插件：单会话双态——先以调度员身份与你交互完成产品设计（并行研究员调研 → 方案 → 决策清点 → 定稿），一句确认后切换为调度引擎，goal 驱动自动推进开发流水线（审核员计划审核 → 开发员执行自测 → 审核员 AC 证据核验+代码审查 → 调度员构建），推进到「待人工测试」硬停止等你实测；验收阶段走修复循环（T0~T3 证据链）。
>
> **当前版本：v2.10.1**（2026-10-13 发布）　|　**相对上版 v2.10.0 的差异**：codegraph 闭环强制同步——**每次任务完结必须更新代码图谱**成硬规则：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前，调度员在项目根机械执行 `codegraph sync`，无条件、不分内外层、改了什么就更新什么；未同步不得关闭，验收结论.md 增「codegraph 同步」记录行，关卡3 收尾兜底再同步一次（用户指令 2026-10-13）；规范升 v2.1.6（§六 新增第 7 条闭环门禁 + §六 第 4/6 条与 §2.4 挂引用，经生成器 CG-A~F 六个 op 落地、--check 逐字节校验）；persona 四处同源（A1 连跑前置 sync／新增闭环段／P2-1 修复包前置／收尾门禁 ⓪ 步）＋验收结论模板同步；原子升版（五处版本载体 + pkg-consistency 常量族同候选 commit 切换）。套件 561→561/0（断言数不变）；机器层零改动（dispatch/phase-gate/budget 零改动，不新增状态/环节/角色）。
> **宿主要求**：建议 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 起（0.1.7 声明式预设机制：包内 `presets/agent-preset.patch.yml` 自动生成预设声明层，无需手工处理）；v2.10.1 实测于 DSH web 版与桌面版（Electron，desktop profile）　|　规范：项目目录及协同开发规范 **v2.1**（六区结构，本文档 v2.1.6）

## 版本与能力速览（v2.10.1）

- **codegraph 闭环强制同步（v2.10.1 新增）**：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前，调度员机械执行 `codegraph sync`（不分内外层、改了什么更新什么）；未同步不得关闭，验收结论留同步记录行；收尾兜底再同步；codegraph 不可用按降级口径如实标注，不伪造——图谱始终是最新单一事实源
- **模板目录归集（v2.10.0）**：脚手架四区「按任务复制用」模板 21 件收进各区 `_模板/` 子文件夹，区根不再平铺混杂；三级复制源回退（项目内 `_模板/` → 旧平铺位 → 预设包 spec/templates）老项目无损；规范 v2.1.5
- **三阶段工作流**：交互态设计（grill-me 决策清点开场问档）→ goal 驱动单包开发（一次授权多包连跑，五态流水线）→ 验收修复循环（含审核员修复审查）
- **两类任务场景**：新产品全流程 / 修改已有系统（场景1：现状研究中+目标代码区约束）；另有**技术调研储备**（场景2，独立终态不进开发）
- **首次使用引导与开工门禁（v2.9.0 新增）**：新会话首次对话先探查后告知（插件级 3 项＋项目级 6 项，只列缺失/未验证项，零副作用）；按需授权逐项补齐；`enter_auto_mode` 开发准备门禁 fail-closed（`00-项目管理/开发准备.md` 记录不齐即拒并列缺项）；远程仓库/测试服务器允许「不适用」须写理由，codegraph 不自动降级
- **对话形态纪律（v2.8.0 新增）**：全部人读消息 answer-first + 结尾唯一下一步 + 首尾双问自检 + 分组 ≤5（证据优先于简洁）；提问纪律（一次一决策点/选项 ≤4 推荐置顶/优先卡片提问）；过程消息一行制；不采用项成文（状态.md 唯一真源不散文重述／不删限定词／证据·债务清单不设条数上限／输出更短非目标）
- **子代理模型路由与会话覆盖（v2.7.0 新增）**：每角色默认+降级双槽路由（持久配置现读、原子写、不落在预设同步树）；429/额度类错误自动切降级（G1 硬闸门：插件独占先于宿主重试，不消耗默认模型重试预算；降级失败即停不循环；非适用错误不误降级）；会话临时改模（缺省仅当次主会话、epoch 隔离、在跑 child 快照不受影响、压缩不丢）与显式永久改默认/降级（原子保存、新派工即生效）；「仅下一次」一次性语义明确拒绝不落状态
- **挂载防回归（v2.7.1）**：delegation 组本地模块行必须导出 `apply` 的装配断言（config-check T3h，含缺 apply 夹具检红演算）；注册与更新前体检**双 profile 覆盖**（web 走 CLI、desktop 走 Electron 管理）
- **SpecKit 证据裁决口径（v2.6.1 起）**：AC 证据核验表「证据等级/逐项状态」列；修复包未决澄清闸门、根因初判、正当扩围第三态、上游指针；场景2 裁决三态、反证强制与 `ASSUMPTION` 标记
- **运行安全三层机制（v2.4.x）**：派工生成**三问裁定**；开发员**五条刹车纪律 + 心跳**；**看门狗**（B/C 后台派工、调度员轮内 tick 值班，L0 观察→L1 steer→L2 中断→L3 停机）；恢复轮孤儿接管；审核员计划审核第 5 项判断题
- **调度可靠性机器层**：预算台账 = 环节级 WAL/结算账本（schema v2 身份行 + runId/attempt/派工前阶段/结算后阶段/candidateCommit/evidencePath 六列）、runId 精确结算、派工返回六态（DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED/FAILED/INTERRUPTED）、dispatch_status 四方一致检查+续跑建议、旧台账 v1→v2 迁移、故障注入五项回归套件
- **质量闸门**：任务包改动点「消费/产出」接口契约 + 计划审核跨改动点冲突扫描；验收「无证或不可证伪即驳回」；修复包 T0 根因→T1 RED→T2 GREEN→T3 回归证据链；代码审查 loadBearing 承重标注；P1-8 审核纪律（不机械重跑/选择性复验/证据缺失驳回）
- **预算纪律**：按包分档三硬上限（小包 4/6/24、大包 8/8/48，派工即计次），token 纯统计、无费用概念
- **与 1.0（orchestrator）并存不替代**：两插件各自独立，按会话独占加载

## 版本沿革（自 v2.0.0）

| 版本 | 日期 | 更新摘要 |
|---|---|---|
| **v2.0.0** | 2026-09-11 | 首个 2.0 插件包：协同开发规范 v2.0（五区结构）+ 模板 23 件；orchestrator2 预设四角色（调度员/研究员/审核员/开发员）钉模型；phase-gate v2（24 轮上限 + 四句开工校验）；budget.mjs token 纯统计；使用手册 |
| **v2.1.0** | 2026-09-14 | 规范 v2.1（六区 + 历史归档区）+ 模板 39 件；新增两大场景：修改已有系统（场景1：现状研究中+目标代码区）与技术调研储备（场景2：独立终态不进开发） |
| **v2.1.1** | 2026-09-15 | 可靠性加固：状态头「规范版本」fail-closed；`dispatch_begin/end/status` 派工原子半步（预算派工前拒绝 + 写锁 + 台账预登记/回填 + 悬空识别）；enter_auto_mode 幂等守卫（预设层）；设计冻结哈希清单（设计基线.json 篡改即拒） |
| **v2.1.2** | 2026-09-15 | 默认模型配置：三子代理钉 `{provider, model, reasoningEffort}`（研究员 deepseek-flash·max / 审核员 k3-256k·max / 开发员 kimi-for-coding·high）；调度员推荐 kimi-coding/k3·max（preset 层不声明会话模型）；lib 源化 |
| **v2.2.0** | 2026-09-16 | 计划质量（SP-TP-A1）：任务包改动点「消费/产出」接口契约（含修复包变体）；计划审核第 4 项 = 跨改动点冲突扫描；派工材料分层（prompt 五要素、权威材料入库）；**授权合并**——设计确认即开发授权、测过自动放行下一包；#32 三角色模型配置提示移至定稿时 |
| **v2.3.0** | 2026-09-16 | 修复质量 + 调度可靠性（SP-TP-A2/TP-B）：修复包 T0 根因→T1 RED→T2 GREEN→T3 回归证据链；验收「无证或不可证伪驳回」；代码审查 loadBearing 承重标注；P1-8 审核纪律。机器层：台账 schema v2（身份行+六新列）、runId 精确结算、派工返回六态、dispatch_status 恢复建议、旧台账 v1→v2 迁移、故障注入五项入回归 |

| **v2.6.1** | 2026-09-28 | TP2-SpecKit 证据裁决口径落地：AC 证据等级/逐项状态列、修复包澄清与根因/扩围/上游指针、场景2裁决与反证门槛、版本护栏与声明件同步；安装包、zip、注册和 `web --dump-config` 体检完成。 |
| **v2.7.0** | 2026-10-02 | T3 子代理模型路由与会话覆盖：三角色默认/降级持久路由（DSH_HOME JSON 现读）、429/额度自动降级（G1 独占/一次切换/终局传播/不吞取消）、会话临时改模与显式永久配置（set/reset/inspect 嵌套 route）；官方钉模型注册行替换为插件自持派工（先绑定后派工）；同日被 v2.7.1 取代 |
| **v2.7.1** | 2026-10-03 | T3-TP1-修复1：组合树挂载被拒修复（两纯库模块补空 `apply` 空载——cordis `registry.plugin()` 拒绝无 apply 模块 → never started → 预设挂载被拒）；config-check 新增 T3h 本地模块行 apply 导出断言（含检红夹具）防回归；注册与更新前体检双 profile（web+desktop）覆盖 |

| **v2.9.0** | 2026-10-08 | 引导 首次使用引导：persona 新增【首次使用引导】（新会话首消息探查后告知缺项）＋ enter_auto_mode 开发准备门禁（fail-closed 五条件）＋ 开发准备.md 模板（规范 v2.1.4，§4.6＋§十索引 40 件）＋手册首次使用节；套件 529→540/0；D-J1 随升版清偿 |
| **v2.10.0** | 2026-10-11 | 归集/TP1-模板目录归集：四区 21 件按任务复制模板归集入各区 `_模板/` 子目录，区根只留正式文件；三级复制源回退成文（老项目不强制整改）；规范 v2.1.5（生成器 31 op，§2.2 树 + §10 索引 + 散文面指针同步）；测试六套件同步 + 21 条旧平铺位防回归断言；原子升版（五载体+常量族同 commit）；套件 540→561/0。机器层零改动 |
| **v2.10.1** | 2026-10-13 | codegraph 闭环强制同步（用户指令）：任何任务包（含修复包）置「已完成」前调度员机械执行 `codegraph sync`——无条件、不分内外层、改了什么更新什么；验收结论增「codegraph 同步」记录行；收尾门禁 ⓪ 步兜底；不可用时降级如实标注。规范 v2.1.6（生成器 CG-A~F 六 op）；persona 四处同源 + 验收结论模板同步；套件 561→561/0；机器层零改动，不新增状态/环节/角色 |

## 安装

本仓库为**发布镜像**（只含最新版本）。安装包：`05-交付/安装包/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1/`（或同名 zip 解压到本地目录后按目录安装）。

**web 版（`dsh web`，profile=web，CLI 一条命令）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/路径/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1
```

**桌面版（Electron，profile=desktop，由应用专属管理，CLI 写入会被拒 `managed exclusively by the Electron application`）：**

1. 打开桌面版**插件管理**界面（设置 → 插件），添加/更新插件，方式选「本地目录（link）」，指向 `…/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1` 包目录；
2. 若界面不可用或需脚本化，可用**手工三件套**（操作前备份原文件）：① 改 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 link 依赖行指向新包目录；② 同步 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 对应两行；③ 把 `node_modules/dsh-orchestrator2` junction 重指到新包目录。

**两端通用**：装完**完全退出并重启**（桌面版注意先退出托盘进程，避免旧实例占端口）；新建会话在预设选择器选「自动开发调度器2.0」。重启前建议体检：`node "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" web --dump-config`——① 组合树含 `preset-orchestrator2`；② 零死引用；③ 注册指向新包。详见包根 `测试入口说明.md` 与包内 `presets/orchestrator2/docs/使用手册.md`。

> 注：0.1.7 起预设走声明式机制（包内 `presets/agent-preset.patch.yml` 在宿主启动时自动把预设声明进组合树）；旧版「裸目录拷贝到 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets`」方式已随 0.1.7 移除，勿再用。

## 仓库结构（发布镜像：源码 + 最新交付物 + 安装位子包）

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `02-代码/orchestrator2/` | 2.0 预设工程**源码**：persona（agent.cordis.yml）/ 规范 v2.1 与 40 件模板（四区按任务模板收 `_模板/` 子目录）/ dispatch.mjs 机器层 / model-routes 等路由四模块 / tests 回归套件（561 断言） |
| `05-交付/安装包/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1/` | 当前安装包（61 件：presets/spec/lib/docs + 测试入口说明 + LICENSE + package.json） |
| `05-交付/安装包/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1.zip` | 同名压缩包（下载即用） |
| `plugins/dsh-orchestrator2/` | **安装位子包**（不带版本号，随发版原地刷新）：`dsh plugin add` 源码安装与插件市场（dsh-market）从这里装，内容为当前安装包镜像 |

> 设计文档、开发过程记录、历史版本安装包与本地开发历史不在本镜像（发布口径）。规范 v2.1 六区结构中的其余各区（00 项目管理/01 设计/03 开发协同/04 测试）属开发侧材料，不公开发布。

## 文档入口

- 使用手册（最新）：`05-交付/安装包/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1/presets/orchestrator2/docs/使用手册.md`
- 协同开发规范 v2.1：`02-代码/orchestrator2/spec/项目目录及协同开发规范-v2.1.md`
- 插件工程说明：`02-代码/orchestrator2/README.md`
- 安装后实测指引：`05-交付/安装包/dsh-orchestrator2-v2.10.1/测试入口说明.md`

plugins.description: Permission-wall-immune file search for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the find_file agent tool skips unreadable directories, reports them with errno, and never lets a failed walk pose as an empty result.

# dsh-find-file

[![DSH Market 已收录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-zh.svg)](https://dsh.market/?plugin=Ronniealgo%2Fdsh-find-file)
[![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file?ref=badge)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）注册一个 `find_file` agent 工具：按文件名通配符（`*`、`?`）在指定根目录下找文件，撞上权限墙不会整次作废——读不了的目录跳过并如实上报，结果里永远标明这次搜索是否完整。纯 Node 实现，零运行时依赖，Node ≥ 20。

> **上架状态（2026-10-11 核对）**：三家目录均已收录 —— [DSH 插件市场](https://dsh.market/?plugin=Ronniealgo%2Fdsh-find-file)（提交单 [issue 226](https://github.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/issues/226) 已按「已收录」办结）、[dshfind.com](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file)、滚动榜单 [dshmk.com](https://dshmk.com/plugins/1413258695)。收录与验证均为自动检测结果，不等于安全审计，也不代表 DSH 官方背书。

同一棵树的两种命运：

```
树里有 1 个匹配，还有 2 个普通进程读不了的目录（Windows ACL）：

内置 glob  →  Error: glob search failed (exit 2): rg: ... 拒绝访问。 (os error 5)
              已扫到的结果全部丢弃。"到底有没有？"——无从谈起。

find_file  →  matches: [ "C:\\...\\pdftotext.exe" ]        ← 照常返回
              skipped: [ { path: "...", code: "EPERM" }, … ]
              complete: false, incompleteReason: "permission-denied"
```

## 为什么需要它

DSH 内置 glob 工具把搜索委托给 ripgrep。在 Windows 上扫宽目录——`C:\Program Files`、用户主目录、盘根——几乎必然撞上系统级 ACL：`C:\Program Files\WindowsApps` 这类目录对普通进程就是拒绝访问，rg 以非零码退出，报错类似 `Error: glob search failed (exit 2): rg: ... 拒绝访问。 (os error 5)`。此时 glob 的行为是整次作废：只要 ripgrep 以 ≥2 的退出码结束，整条搜索连同已扫到的结果一起丢弃，模型拿到的只有这一条 Error。

真正的伤害在语义上：一次"因为权限失败"的搜索和一次"没找到"的搜索，在下游推理里很容易被混为一谈，于是"文件不存在"的错误结论就从一次失败的搜索里被顺手推出来了。本插件把"部分失败"当成一等结果：读不了的目录跳过（不中断搜索），连同 errno 一起写进结果；任何让覆盖不完整的因素——权限、时间预算、结果上限、深度上限——都会把 `complete` 置为 `false` 并给出 `incompleteReason`。这次搜索覆盖了多少、缺了哪一块，变成模型可以直接读到的事实，不用猜。

## 安装

两种方式都只动两个位置：profile 的 `node_modules` 下建一个目录联接（junction），`cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一行插件声明。

### 方式一：install.ps1 一键装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Ronniealgo/dsh-find-file.git
cd dsh-find-file
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1              # 装进 desktop profile
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1 -Uninstall   # 卸载
```

脚本只做两件事：把本目录 junction 进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-find-file`，并在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加 `- insert:` 块。每次改动前先写时间戳备份，`-Uninstall` 按同一算法把行删回去（备份保留，可逐字节还原）。`-Profile` 指定其它 profile，`-DshHome` 指定其它 DSH 主目录。

### 方式二：手动

1. 建联接（junction 不需要管理员权限）：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-find-file" -Target "C:\path\to\dsh-find-file"
```

2. 在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加（`config:` 可整体省略，四个键都有默认值）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: find-file
      name: dsh-find-file
      config:
        maxResults: 50
        timeBudgetMs: 90000
        maxDepth: 64
        includeDirs: false
```

3. 重启 DSH，到 设置 → 插件 里确认 dsh-find-file 已启用。

> 写错键名不会静默失效：未知配置键在插件加载时直接抛错（刻意设计，见「配置」）。

## 使用

### 作为 agent 工具（find_file）

工具注册后，必填参数只有两个：`root`（搜索起点，目录或单个文件）和 `pattern`（纯文件名模式：`*` 匹配任意长度，`?` 恰好一个字符，其余按字面匹配；不允许路径分隔符——要找子目录里的东西，就把 root 指到那个子目录）。四个上限可选。

```json
{
  "root": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData",
  "pattern": "pdftotext.exe",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

返回（真实字段）：

```json
{
  "root": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData",
  "pattern": "pdftotext.exe",
  "matches": [
    "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\poppler\\Library\\bin\\pdftotext.exe"
  ],
  "matchedCount": 1,
  "dirsWalked": 14120,
  "symlinkSkipped": 3,
  "skippedCount": 2,
  "skipped": [
    { "path": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\ipc-lock", "code": "EPERM" },
    { "path": "C:\\Users\\me\\AppData\\Roaming\\VendorX\\protected", "code": "EACCES" }
  ],
  "complete": false,
  "incompleteReason": "permission-denied",
  "elapsedMs": 8421,
  "limits": {
    "maxResults": 100,
    "timeBudgetMs": 90000,
    "maxDepth": 64,
    "includeDirs": false,
    "caseInsensitive": true
  }
}
```

字段速览：`matches` 是绝对路径（按遍历顺序，封顶 `maxResults`）；`dirsWalked` 是成功读取的目录数；`symlinkSkipped` 是看到但未跟随的符号链接/junction 数；`skipped` 是读不了的目录清单，每条带 errno 代码（最多列 30 条，总数看 `skippedCount`）；`limits` 是这次调用实际生效的上限。

工具返回给模型的文本块永远以 VERDICT 行收尾，例如：

```
find_file: 1 match(es) · 14120 dirs walked · 8421 ms · search INCOMPLETE (permission-denied)
  C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\Programs\poppler\Library\bin\pdftotext.exe
skipped 2 dir(s): C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\Temp\ipc-lock (EPERM); C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\VendorX\protected (EACCES)
symlinks/junctions not followed: 3
VERDICT: search incomplete — absence here is NOT proof of absence overall. Narrow the root or recheck before concluding.
```

### 作为 CLI

```powershell
node bin\find-file.mjs C:\Users\me\AppData pdftotext.exe --max-results 100
node bin\find-file.mjs C:\Users\me\Documents "*.pdf" --include-dirs --quiet
```

选项：`--max-results N`、`--time-budget-ms N`、`--max-depth N`、`--include-dirs`、`--case-sensitive`、`--quiet`（只打印匹配路径）。退出码：`0` = 搜索完成（0 个匹配也算完成）；`1` = 致命错误（root 访问不了）；`2` = 用法错误（参数或模式不合法）。

## complete 的语义（这个插件的核心）

- `complete: true`——预算内把 root 下整棵树读完。只有这时，`matchedCount: 0` 才允许下结论「该文件在此 root 下不存在」。
- symlink / junction 一律不跟随，计入 `symlinkSkipped`。这是刻意策略（Windows 上 junction 环会让天真的遍历永不终止），不算覆盖缺口，也不影响 `complete`。
- `complete: false`——搜索不完整，「没找到」不成立。`incompleteReason` 只有四个值：
  - `permission-denied`：有目录读不了，清单在 `skipped`；
  - `time-budget`：时间预算用尽；
  - `result-limit`：匹配数到达 `maxResults`；
  - `depth-limit`：树比 `maxDepth` 深。
- 实用规则：`complete: false` 时先缩小 root 或放宽上限重查，再谈存在与否。

## 配置

四个 entry config 键（写进 cordis.patch.yml 的 `config:` 块），每次调用可用同名参数覆盖：

| 键 | 范围 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxResults` | 1–1000 | `50` | 命中即停，标记 `result-limit` |
| `timeBudgetMs` | 1000–600000 | `90000` | 毫秒墙钟预算，用尽即停，标记 `time-budget` |
| `maxDepth` | 1–256 | `64` | root 下的目录层数，超过标记 `depth-limit` |
| `includeDirs` | `true` / `false` | `false` | 目录名也参与匹配；匹配到的目录仍会被深入遍历 |

- 越界数值会被夹回范围内（不是报错）；类型错误和未知键抛错。
- 未知键抛错是刻意设计：patch 里把 `maxResults` 拼成 `maxRsults`，必须炸在加载时，而不是静默退回默认值。
- `caseInsensitive` 不是 entry config 键；调用时可显式传，不传则按平台取默认——win32/darwin 不区分大小写，其余平台区分。CLI 对应 `--case-sensitive`。

## 与内置 glob 的对比

| | 内置 glob | `find_file` |
|---|---|---|
| 撞上读不了的目录 | 整次搜索作废，返回 `Error: glob search failed (exit 2)` | 跳过该目录继续搜，`skipped` 里记下 `{path, code}` |
| 已扫到的结果 | 全部丢弃 | 照常返回，`complete: false` 明示覆盖不完整 |
| 「没找到」的可信度 | 失败时无意义 | `complete: true` 且 0 匹配 ⇒ 确定不存在 |
| 部分覆盖的可见性 | 无 | `incompleteReason` 说明缺哪一类 |
| 匹配目标 | glob 模式匹配整条路径 | 纯文件名 `*` / `?`（不许路径分隔符） |
| 运行时依赖 | ripgrep 二进制 | 无（node:fs/promises + node:path） |

## 测试与开发

```bash
npm test        # 显式点名 4 个测试文件，零依赖，无需 npm install
npm run check   # node --check 全部源文件
```

要求 Node ≥ 20。引擎（lib/walk.js）的文件系统与时钟是注入的，单测不碰真实磁盘；CLI 测试会真实拉起 bin/find-file.mjs。更完整的来龙去脉见 [docs/MOTIVATION.md](docs/MOTIVATION.md)。

## 已知限制

- 不跟随 symlink/junction：链接目标下的树不会被覆盖（结果里以 `symlinkSkipped` 计数明示）。
- 只按文件名匹配：不做内容搜索，不支持 `a/**/b` 这类路径 glob。
- `skipped` 清单最多 30 条（`skippedCount` 始终准确）；`matches` 封顶 `maxResults`。
- 为 Windows ACL 场景设计；慢速网络盘靠 `timeBudgetMs` 兜底。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text: Web profile plugin — host half + browser half. > **English**: [README.md](README.md) | **中文**: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) --- # DSH Hardware Sandbox **A 3D hardware sandbox for DSH: build the assembly, wire it up, and run your project's own code against virtual hardware.** **Install (from GitHub; this package is not published on npm)** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Noob-stupid/dsh-breadboard ``` Then reload the page. The sandbox registers into the **`main`** slot (the 3D view) and the **`sidebar.panellist`** slot (the panels); `skill/SKILL.md` ships with the plugin, so an agent that has it installed already knows how to drive it. **Like it?** Open this plugin's page in the Plugins manager — its own bottom-right corner carries a small, plain-text link to [give it a star on GitHub](https://github.com/Noob-stupid/dsh-breadboard). It is one transparent line, no box, no banner, and it only ever appears on this plugin's page. Three things make that one line work — all three are in this repository: | Requirement | Where | Note | |---|---|---| | repo topic `dsh-plugin` | GitHub repository topics | makes the repo discoverable in community lists | | a `dsh.bundle` manifest | `package.json` → `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` | **without it `dsh plugin add` installs nothing** — and the UI symptom is misleading: the plugin list says "no composition bundle declared", while what actually broke is the assembly, so every `/api/*` returns 404 and the panel simply never appears | | an exported `apply(ctx)` | `src/index.ts` (host) / `src/client/index.ts` (browser) | host half registers routes, tools and the simulation engine; browser half registers the two slots above | ## What it is / what it solves Normally the parts of a hardware project you can only *try on the real board* are the wiring itself, the sensor semantics at register level, and the failure handling. This plugin moves those into a virtual scene that actually runs: - **3D assembly** — drop parts from the built-in model library (ESP32, Raspberry Pi 4B, BME280, HC-SR501 PIR, LED module, MPL3115A2, breadboard), wire them port by port, and get a live SSOT (single source of truth) assembly state with topology and electrical checks. - **Project-level hardware-in-the-loop** — a **real Python process** runs **your project's code**. A Python shim intercepts its `smbus`/I2C access and answers from virtual devices, so the project under test reads register-level values (e.g. it performs the real BME280 compensation math on data coming from the virtual chip). - **Networked-device emulation** (a second, separate class of virtual hardware) — a device that actively POSTs to **your** external HTTP backend on a real cadence: register → pull config → periodic report. Verified end-to-end against a real seat-selection system (device → HTTP → backend state machine → database). - **Failure injection** — unplug a wire, return NACK, force a reading, take a device offline, and watch whether the project's error handling actually catches it. - **Project-level convenience** — scan a real project folder to learn which hardware it needs, and switch the entire hardware setup in one click. Requires DSH with the **`web`** profile and `webServer`, `tools` and `subprocess` services. The host half declares them as **hard `inject` dependencies on purpose**: if any of them is missing the plugin does not activate at all, rather than activating with tools silently unregistered, a blank panel, or a simulation engine that cannot spawn. ### See it without a real project `examples/zhizuo-virtual-esp32/` is a standalone script version of the virtual ESP32 seat sensor. `hw_list_projects` lists the built-in demo project (**zhizuo-seat-node**) together with whether it is currently wired end to end; `hw_import_project` puts its parts, wires and network binding in place in one call. ## UI tour The interface is currently **Chinese only** — the labels below are the literal ones on screen. | Panel | What it does | |---|---| | **③ Project (one-click hardware swap)** | the main workflow. Per project body: file count (`N files (M skipped while sampling)` when sampling skipped files), **Scan requirements**, **Delete**; plus **+ Import project body (pick folder)** and **+ Import model bundle (pick folder)** | | **① Add component** | click a model key to drop it into the scene (collapsed by default) | | **② Re-skin models** | search for a model / import a file, and re-skin one of the model keys above; a model key with no geometry renders as a placeholder box (collapsed by default) | | **Statistics** | render statistics (draw calls / triangles / FPS) — pure read, off by default | | **Center 3D view** | placed components with world transforms, **blue cables** between ports, spatial warning boxes drawn on the components that have `warn`/`error` warnings, gizmo/right-click menu (pin, delete), port tooltips | | **Panel overlay input box** | send a message to the current session without leaving the panel; if the host exposes no `agents` service the box is hidden (`capabilities.chat` is absent) | Two of those deserve emphasis: - **Scan requirements is a UI button only.** It is not exposed as an agent tool — the agent side has no equivalent. What the agent *can* do is everything after that: place parts, wire them, build a project blueprint, run simulations. - **Deleting a project only deletes the project definition** (that one JSON). It does **not** touch the scene, so removing a project never wipes the hardware you have on screen. ## Quick start: three steps 1. **Import the project body** — *+ Import project body (pick folder)*, point it at a **complete project folder** (frontend + backend + hardware code). It is imported **without** models; the host reads it to work out which hardware it needs. 2. **Scan what hardware it needs** — the **Scan requirements** button in the ③ panel (UI only, see above). The report lists each candidate model key with the **evidence** — which files it was seen in — so you can judge it yourself; when the scan had to sample, it says so instead of implying it read everything. 3. **Import a model bundle** — *+ Import model bundle (pick folder)*, a folder laid out as `/model.glb`. Whatever you skip keeps rendering as a placeholder box. Or skip steps 1–3 entirely: describe the system to the agent and let it call **`hw_save_project`** to write a blueprint, then **`hw_import_project`** to place every part, wire and network binding in one go. ## Agent tools: 16 `hw_*` tools This is the actual registered list (nothing added, nothing omitted). The **when to use** column is the point of the table: these tools are not interchangeable. ### Projects | Tool | What it does | When to use it | |---|---|---| | `hw_list_projects` | list built-in hardware projects: parts, wires, network config, and whether each is currently wired end to end | **before** hand-placing anything — a blueprint is one call, hand-assembly is four steps and a missed step fails silently | | `hw_import_project` | import a project: **clears the current assembly first**, then places parts, wires and network bindings | switching the whole hardware set; note it *replaces*, it does not add | | `hw_save_project` | create or overwrite a project blueprint (stored under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-hardware-sandbox/projects/`) | the user described a system in words — write it down as a blueprint, then import it | ### Assembly | Tool | What it does | When to use it | |---|---|---| | `hw_get_assembly` | read the SSOT summary: revision, components, connections, warnings (with their `message`, not just the code), power summary, virtual devices | **before every edit** — you need the real port ids; port ids are pin identities (`E4`), not silkscreen names (`GPIO23`) | | `hw_edit_assembly` | one tool over the contract's `ClientAction` union: place / move / rotate / connect / disconnect / remove / pin | any change to the scene. It takes an action object, so read the samples

plugins.description: DSH 自由工作台插件 —— tab 化多会话 · 自由分栏 · 每窗格宿主原版对话框 (DeepSeek Harness plugin)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-newtype-multititle

**DSH 自由工作台插件** —— 把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话区变成一个 tab 化、可自由分栏的多会话工作台。每个窗格都是**宿主原版对话框**（markdown / 工具卡 / 输入框 / 模型选择全在），不是自绘投影。

![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-v0.1.1-blue) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.1.7~0.2.0--rc.2-green) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey)

![自由工作台：多会话并行 · 自由分栏 · 每窗格宿主原版对话框](docs/shots/hero.webp)

## 功能

- **自由分栏工作台**：基于 [trellis](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@danfessler/trellis) 的拖拽 dock —— 拖 tab 到边缘分栏、拖到中心并入、双击聚焦（zoom）、布局自动持久化，重启恢复。
- **多会话并行**：每个窗格独立 retain 一份会话引用，窗格内是宿主 `conversation.content` factory 渲染的**原版对话框**。
- **对话 / 轨迹切换**：tab 齿轮菜单切换标准对话与轨迹视图，模式随布局持久化。
- **产出物右栏**：常驻挂载、按会话归档的产出物流，点击直达工作台窗格。
- **内置浏览器**：工作台内开浏览器 tab，不依赖宿主右栏。桌面版走 Electron webview（官方 dshDesktop 桥），不受 X-Frame-Options 限制，大站不白屏；web 版回落 iframe + 外部打开兜底。
- **文件窗格**：点对话内文件 → 只读文件窗格；md 自动排版渲染（marked）+ mermaid 图表，颜色跟随主题。
- **启动对齐**：重启后自动恢复 session tab，会话服务未就绪时退避重试（500ms × 12），不弹「无法读取对话」。

## 安装

```sh
# 方式一：Release 下载 tgz 直装（免构建，推荐）
#   从 https://github.com/Asthmatic123/dsh-newtype-multititle/releases 下载 .tgz
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <下载的>.tgz

# 方式二：本地路径安装（web profile 同理加 --profile web）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本仓库克隆路径>

# 方式三：从源码构建后安装
git clone https://github.com/Asthmatic123/dsh-newtype-multititle.git
cd dsh-newtype-multititle && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .
```

## 版本兼容

| dsh 版本 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 0.1.7-rc.2 | ✅ 主验证线 |
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | ✅ 已验证（desktop profile 实装） |

兼容口径：`peerDependencies` 跨 minor 区间（`>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.2.1`）。0.1.7 与 0.2.0 的六个接缝（`conversation.content` factory / SessionProvider 座位 / `sidebar.panellist` / `sidebar.right.pane.tab` / 拖拽协议 / 基础 CSS 变量）逐条比对一致。

## 构建

```sh
npm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
npm test            # node --test（纯逻辑层）
npm run build       # tsdown → lib/index.js（服务端 ESM）+ lib/client.js（客户端 CJS，__ModuleLoader__ 包装）
```

## 架构速览

```
src/
  index.ts            服务端半：cordis 插件，图页只读文件服务（127.0.0.1 白名单根，2MB 上限）
  client/
    index.tsx         客户端入口：slots 注入（main newtype / sidebar.panellist / 右栏产出物）
    workbench/
      WorkbenchView.tsx        trellis 工作台（布局持久化 / 拖拽桥 / 空态预置）
      HostConversationPane.tsx 宿主 factory 窗格（retain 状态机 + 启动退避重试）
      SessionPane.tsx          降级兜底（eventSource 只读投影）
      SessionAccessories.tsx   tab 配件（齿轮菜单 / 右栏开关 / 浏览器按钮）
  client/newtype.module.css    样式（lightningcss 内联，内容指纹 tagId 注入）
```

设计要点：

- **平台模块 external**：react / cordis / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` 等由宿主 loader 冻结模块表提供；跨插件 value import 构建期直接报错（bundle purity gate）。
- **CSS 内容指纹注入**：`<style>` 以 `sha1(css)` 前 8 位为 tagId，热更新只清同 tagId，多 CSS 模块互不覆盖。
- **localStorage 键沿用 `dsh-newtype.*` 前缀**：布局 / 图页策略 / 打开方式选择在改名前后互通。

## 已知限制

- 多窗格并发输入（R10）：多实例 factory 的草稿/焦点归属由宿主决定，同时往多个窗格打字可能互相打断；发送请先点目标窗格聚焦。
- 轨迹视图在嵌入形态的可用性依宿主版本而定，不可用时齿轮中该视图显示降级文案。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) browser plugin: give your agent hands inside the Chrome you already use — native messaging + CDP, no TCP port, no Connect button, 9 native browser_* tools.
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文 · Development notes

--- **Give your DSH agent hands inside the Chrome you are already using** — your logins, your tabs, your session. Install once, no Connect button, ever. ![the in-page cursor driving a real page](assets/cursor-demo.gif) Every click flies a cursor to the target and labels what it is doing. It renders *inside the page*, so it lands in screenshots too — you and the model look at the same picture. ## ✨ Why another browser bridge? Every existing option makes you click something, every time: | Option | What goes wrong | |---|---| | `chrome-devtools-mcp --autoConnect` | Chrome asks *"Allow remote debugging?"* on **every** connection | | Browser MCP (store extension) | You must click the extension icon → **Connect** on **every** tab | | WebSocket-based bridges | Open a TCP port and trust anything that can reach it | | **dsh-chrome-bridge** | Nothing to click. Nothing listening on a port. | Three things make the difference: - 🔌 **Native messaging, not a port.** The extension talks to a local Node host over Chrome's native messaging pipe; the CLI reaches the host through a `0600` Unix socket guarded by a token. No TCP port to scan, no origin to spoof. - 🎯 **`chrome.debugger`, not injected scripts.** Clicks and keystrokes are dispatched as real CDP `Input.*` events, so they carry a user gesture — popups open, focus works, and sites that reject synthetic events behave normally. Screenshots, network, console and raw CDP come for free. - 👀 **A cursor the human can see.** A translucent light-blue arrow with a "🌐 DSH" name tag glides along a gentle arc to the target; the tag says what it is doing (click / type / drag / scroll) and each click leaves a soft ripple. It shares one style with the desktop cursor of [dsh-mac-computer-use](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mac-computer-use) (solid there, with a monitor icon), so you can tell at a glance whether the work is in the browser or on the desktop. It sits above modals and fullscreen, and picks up where it was after a navigation. Because it is rendered inside the page, **it appears in screenshots**. ## 🏗 Architecture ``` DSH's agent (provided by the harness — this repo ships none) ├── browser_* tools (DSH plugin) ─┐ └── cb CLI (shell) ─┤ ▼ Unix socket /tmp/dsh-bridge.sock (0600 + token) ▼ Node native host ←─ native messaging (stdio) ─→ Chrome extension (MV3) │ chrome.debugger ▼ real CDP ``` **This repo ships no agent** — the agent above is DSH's own; we only give it hands. The extension ID is fixed by the public key embedded in `plugin/vendor/extension/manifest.json`, so it is **identical on every machine** and the native-host registration never needs editing. ## 🚀 Install **The host ships inside the plugin package.** Adding the plugin copies the native host and the MV3 extension into place and registers native messaging for you — no `git clone`, no `install.sh`, no `python3`. Requirements: **macOS**, **Google Chrome 116+**, **Node.js 18+**. **1.** Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → paste this → Install → Enable → **restart DSH**: ``` https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge/releases/latest/download/dsh-chrome-bridge.tgz ``` **2.** The plugin installs itself on first load (`~/.dsh/chrome-bridge`, `~/dsh-bridge-extension`, plus `com.dsh.bridge.json` in Chrome's `NativeMessagingHosts`). Loading the extension into Chrome is the one step nothing can do for you — Chrome 137+ removed `--load-extension`, and the Web Store does not accept the `debugger` permission. So the plugin walks you to that click instead: - the first time a `browser_*` tool finds nothing to talk to, it **opens `chrome://extensions` in a background tab** and **puts `~/dsh-bridge-extension` on your clipboard** (once per session; the error text repeats the steps); - in the file picker press **⌘⇧G**, then **⌘V**, then Enter — no folder hunting. Do it once, ever: 1. open `chrome://extensions` 2. enable **Developer mode** (top right) 3. **Load unpacked** → **⌘⇧G** → **⌘V** → Enter (the folder is already on your clipboard) From a source checkout, `./bridge setup` does exactly this in one command: installs the host, opens the page, copies the path, and waits until the extension connects — printing ✅ when it does. **3.** Verify (the `cb` CLI is installed along the way): ```bash cb status # host pid … | extension connected: ✅ cb tabs ``` Until step 2 is done the `browser_*` tools fail **loudly with exactly these steps** — never silently. ### 🧩 The eleven native tools | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `browser_tabs` | list / find / open / close / activate tabs | | `browser_read` | **numbered list of clickable / fillable elements** (`snapshot`), visible text, HTML, attributes, page info | | `browser_click` | click by element number (`ref`), selector, text, or coordinates | | `browser_input` | type, press keys, select, upload, hover, scroll | | `browser_nav` | go to a URL, **back / forward / reload**, and wait for load | | `browser_screenshot` | screenshot **returned as an image** (viewport / full / element) | | `browser_eval` | run JS in the page | | `browser_wait` | wait for an element, **a piece of text, or a URL** — or for it to go away (`gone`) | | `browser_dialog` | release alert / confirm / prompt | | `browser_drag` | drag by element number, selector, **visible text** or coordinates — HTML5 drag-and-drop and mouse-driven widgets (sliders, sortable lists) | | `browser_devtools` | **console output + uncaught JS errors, network requests (status, timing), a request's response body** | > A freshly installed bundle is not hot-loaded; DSH must be restarted once. > `dsh plugin add` from the CLI refuses the app-managed profile — use the sidebar there. > Plugin updates are not automatic in DSH yet: to upgrade, uninstall and install again. ### 👀 What you see while it works - **Click the toolbar icon** for a live panel: whether Chrome ↔ local host ↔ DSH are connected, **which DSH sessions are driving which tabs** (jump to a tab, or release it with one click), the last actions with their errors, a **pause switch** that makes the browser off-limits until you turn it back on, and *copy diagnostics* for bug reports. The icon badge shows how many tabs are under control (`!` = host down, `⏸` = paused). - **In DSH, Plugins → Chrome Bridge** has a settings card too: connection status, whether the extension is the local or the Web Store build, which tabs are under control (release them all with one click), plus pause and on-page-cursor switches. When it isn't connected it tells you the missing step and can open the install page for you. **Resuming control only works from the Chrome extension panel** — the model can reach the DSH side as well, so that click has to be yours. - Every tab the agent touches **joins a blue tab group

plugins.description: Push-to-talk dictation for DeepSeek Harness: hold a single key in the composer, speak, release — the transcript lands in your draft.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-voice-ptt

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Push-to-talk dictation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): **hold a single key in the composer, speak, release** — the transcript is inserted into your draft.

No chord to memorise. Hold **F2**, release, done.

---

## What it does

1. Put the cursor in the composer. While it is focused and the draft is empty, a faint hint appears in the toolbar: `Hold F2 to dictate`.
2. **Hold F2** — recording starts and the hint becomes `Recording — release F2 to finish`.
3. **Release** — the audio is transcribed and the text lands at the caret in your draft.

While dictating:

- Press `Esc`, or press any other key (say, the letter you meant to type), to cancel and discard the recording.
- Losing window focus, or switching the tab away, cancels the recording rather than capturing unrelated audio.
- Exceeding the recognizer's limit stops the recording automatically and transcribes what it got.

## Changing the key

The hint **is a button**. Click it to expand the candidate keys, click one, and it applies immediately and is remembered (in `localStorage`).

| Key | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **F2** (default) | Function key: types no character, minimal conflicts |
| F4 | Function key, further right |
| Insert | Right hand on full-size keyboards; absent on many laptops |
| Right Ctrl | Comfortable for the right pinky |
| Right Shift | Right pinky; on Windows, five taps can trigger Sticky Keys |

Modifier keys work properly: the plugin knows the hold key *is* a modifier, so it does not mistake it for a chord and pass the event through.

The hint, the status line, and these key names follow your DSH language (`en` / `zh`).

To offer a different key, edit `KEY_OPTIONS` at the top of `lib/client.js` (a `{code, labelKey}` array, `code` spelled as `KeyboardEvent.code`, `labelKey` naming an entry in the zh / en dictionaries at the top of the same file).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-ptt
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the command appends it to the profile's bundle stack and mounts it — no hand-editing of `cordis.patch.yml`. From a Git checkout, pin the revision:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:eicon-xyz/dsh-voice-ptt#<commit>'
```

Requires the speech recognizer. Install and enable `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle` and prepare a model once (roughly 230 MB). If the recognizer is not ready, holding the key reports a visible reason in the status line instead of failing silently.

### Development

```sh
# mount the checkout directly instead of installing
ln -sfn "$PWD" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-voice-ptt"
# then add to the profile's own cordis.patch.yml:
#   - insert:
#       - id: dsh-voice-ptt
#         name: 'dsh-voice-ptt'
```

Remove that manual mount line before switching to the bundle channel, or the row is mounted twice.

## Why a single key needs its own keyboard handling

The official shortcut service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-shortcuts`) dispatches **`keydown` only** — there is no `keyup` event to end a hold. It also rejects modifier-free bindings (`bindingIssue` returns `modifier-required`) and, on the web, restricts chords to a platform allow-list.

So "hold one key and talk" cannot be expressed as a shortcut command. This plugin owns the keyboard instead: document-level `keydown` starts, `keyup` finishes. The trade-off is that it cannot appear in **Settings → Shortcuts**, which is why the key picker lives in the composer.

### Keeping a single key from becoming a second modifier

| Situation | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Focus is not in a composer | Does not start recording |
| Any other key pressed while recording | Cancels the take; that key works normally (hold Right Ctrl, press A → `Ctrl+A` still applies) |
| A dialog or menu is open | Yields the key |
| Modified press (`Ctrl+F2`, `Alt+F2`, …) | Not intercepted at all |
| Focus is in a terminal | Not intercepted (xterm needs function keys) |

## How it works

- **Draft insertion** uses the session-scoped `inputActions` (`captureInsertion` + `insertText`). The plugin registers a resident entry in `conversation.input.left` to record each session's actions; that same entry renders the status line, the focus hint, and the key picker.
- **Recording** uses `MediaRecorder` and resamples through `OfflineAudioContext` to 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV — the same format the official voice-input plugin sends — then calls the host's `speech.transcribe`.
- **The host half is deliberately empty.** Every behaviour lives in the browser half, reached through `dsh.client`.

## Files

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: keys, recording, transcription, status line, key picker |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half (intentionally empty, so the bundle row is mountable) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | `dsh.bundle.patch` layer the installer merges |
| `test/` | Headless-Chrome end-to-end tests |

## Tests

They drive a real browser against a running DSH web profile, with Chrome's fake microphone fed the bundled fixture:

```sh
npm install                       # provides ws
export PTT_TOKEN=<token from the dsh web URL>
node test/e2e.cjs                 # hold → release → transcript inserted
node test/picker.cjs              # picker opens, a new key applies and persists
node test/modifier-key.cjs        # Right Ctrl records; Ctrl+A is not hijacked
node test/nonempty-draft.cjs      # works with a non-empty draft, text is appended
node test/modal-yield.cjs         # yields while a dialog is open, works again after
```

`test/make-fixture.cjs` regenerates `test/fixtures/speech-16k.wav` from any audio Chrome can decode:

```sh
node test/make-fixture.cjs input.mp3        # needs Chrome; no ffmpeg required
```

## Limitations

- Web surface only (the desktop native keyboard bridge is not wired to this plugin).
- No streaming captions: the text appears after you release.
- Never sends automatically — the transcript goes to the draft for you to review.
- One hold key at a time, and only from the built-in candidate list unless you edit `KEY_OPTIONS`.

## License

MIT

# dsh-peak-guard

> **梁文峰是谁？我只认识梁文谷！**
>
> 高峰计价时段，DSH 不许调模型。被拦下的那次调用**不产生任何费用**，
> 用户收到的是一句说明，以及一份「高峰期间拦下了哪些请求」的列表。

[English](README.en.md) · 中文

一个 DSH **宿主 + 客户端**插件。谷时（含周末与法定假期）什么都不做；高峰时段在
`llm/stream` 这个瀑布式事件上直接短路 —— **不调用 `next()`，所以一个字节都不会发往任何模型适配器**，
然后自己捏一段合法的分片流回去，于是那句说明就长在模型的回复位置上。

## 1. 装好之后是什么样

高峰期（默认北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 的工作日）你在 DSH 里发一句话，
模型的回复位置出现的是（默认**正经版**话术）：

```
⛔ 高峰时段暂停模型调用（本次未产生费用）

— 现在是 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），高峰单价约为谷时的 2 倍；本次调用没有产生费用。
谷时 18:00 开始（还有 3 小时 12 分），届时再发即可。
需要现在继续：`/peak off 30`（放行 30 分钟） · 查看状态：`/peak status`
```

想要最初那个彩蛋版（`现在是梁文峰时间，你马内不要了？胆子真是肥嘟嘟的`），
把配置里的 `tone` 设成 `joke`；也可以用 `message` 写任意自定义话术。
不想看下面那几行说明（只留第一句），把 `hint` 设成 `false`。

会话标题生成、上下文压缩这类「管家调用」**默认不拦** —— 拦了只会让标题变成那句说明、
让上下文压不动。真想「高峰期一个 token 都不发」，把 `blockUtilityCalls` 设成 `true`。

### 输入框那一带的两块 UI

**① 左边的盾牌开关**（插槽 `conversation.input.left`）——高峰保护总开关：

| 外观 | 含义 | 悬停提示 |
|---|---|---|
| 灰色盾牌 + 斜杠 | 开关关着 | 「点击打开：高峰时段不调用模型」 |
| 品牌色盾牌 + 对勾 | 开着，现在是谷时，待命中 | 「现在是谷时，模型调用放行；下一段高峰 09:00 开始（2 天 11 小时后）」 |
| 橙色盾牌 + 右上角橙点 | 开着，**现在正在拦** | 「现在是高峰，模型调用会被拦下；谷时 18:00 开始（还有 3 小时 12 分）」 |
| 左上角数字角标 | 被拦截列表里有 N 条（超过 99 显示 `99+`） | —— |

开关状态**落盘**（重启 DSH 后仍然记得），和 `/peak enable|disable` 是同一个状态。
宿主未就绪时它会呈现为灰色不可用态（提示「宿主半边未就绪」）—— 那说明插件代码改过但
**还没重启 DSH**，见下面 §3 的生效方式。

**② 输入框上方的「被拦截列表」卡片**（插槽 `conversation.input.dock` —— 和 DSH 那张「任务」卡同一个座位）
**只读记录 + 两个无害小动作**：高峰期间拦下了哪些请求，看得见、不动作（不排队、不重投、不打扰任何会话）。
只在有记录时出现：

```
⠿ 高峰期间有 2 条请求被拦下    这些请求没有发给模型，也没有产生费用          [ ˇ ] [ ✕ ]
  ● 把 README 里的截图换掉                                              09:52
  ⊘ 帮我看看这个报错                                                    09:41   ← 被关闭收起过的：空心环+斜杠
   ↑ ≤3 条默认展开（最新在前），>3 条默认折叠只留标题；点箭头展开/收起，点 ✕ 把没处理的收起
```

* **✕ 关闭**：卡片把「当时还没处理」的记录**交给宿主收起**（盖上「跳过」戳），并从此默认不再展示已办 ——
  于是卡片随即变空、自己消失；**之后新拦下的请求照旧会出现在卡片上**（关掉之后再勾的已办也仍留在卡上，
  直到下一次关闭）。
  想捞回来就去「拦截记录」页点一下那条的图标，它会恢复成正常待办。与折叠键共用同一套图标键样式
  （20×20、圆角、悬停底色），叉号是 **1.3px**（= DSH 自带的 `ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE`）圆头描边 SVG。
* **● → ✓ → ⊘ 三态勾选**：行首那颗图标有三种状态，**共用同一个 SVG**：
  **实心点**（正常待办）→ 点一下变**对勾**（已办，绿色，文字变淡划掉）→ 再点变回点；
  被「关闭」收起的显示为**空心圆环 + 一道斜杠**（琥珀色，含义是「关掉展示框时它还没被处理」），
  点一下**恢复成正常待办**（单向：没有手动改回跳过态的入口）。
  动画都在同一套描边里完成：圆环由同一个 `<circle>` 从实心撑开（`r` 3→3.7、`fill-opacity` 1→0、
  `stroke-opacity` 0→1，190ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`），对勾与斜杠各自用
  `stroke-dasharray` / `stroke-dashoffset`「画」出来 / 收回去（240ms / 220ms）；
  勾选是**乐观更新**（先动观感再发请求，失败回滚），点了不会有延迟感；
  `prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动关掉过渡。
* **卡片列什么**（纯函数 `cardItems(list, dismissedAtMs)`）：跳过的永不展示；已办则**按时间判** ——
  只有「**关掉那一刻之前**就已办」的才收起。所以**在卡片上勾「已办」不会让那行当场消失**，
  得再关一次卡片才会收起 —— 勾错了随时反悔。开关上那个角标数的就是「还等着处理」的条数。
* 三态都是**纯本地状态**：不影响任何拦截行为，但都会**落盘**
  （`POST /peak-guard/set` 的 `{check:{id,done}}` / `{restore:[id]}` / `{dismiss:true}`），重启后还在。

### 卡头那两枚图标键

* **两个图标键的 DOM 结构必须对称，且 SVG 要 `display:block`**：
  曾经折叠键外面多包了一层 `<span>`，而那条 span 的样式在一次 CSS 重写里被删掉 →
  inline SVG 按**文字基线**对齐，被顶高 **1.44px**（量截图才发现）。
  现在两边都是「按钮里直接装 SVG」，并有回归测试盯着。
* **整组的纵向位置由一个常量控制**：`CHEVRON_Y_SHIFT`（0.5px 一档，负值 = 上移），
  两个箭头方向共用同一段 y 区间，所以展开/收起切换时图标不会上下跳。
* **卡头三枚图标（lead / chevron / close）统一描边 `ICON_STROKE = 1.3`**（对齐 DSH 自带的
  `ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE`，官方那个 16px 关闭键就是 1.3）；列表里的对勾用 `CHECK_STROKE = 1.6` 略重一点。

### 设置 → 拦截记录（管理页）

除了输入框上方那张小卡片，插件还在 **DSH 设置**里注册了一整页「拦截记录」
（插槽 `settings.section`，注册形状照 `dsh-archived-chats`：`{id, order, label}`，
`label` 决定左侧导航文案）。页面结构对齐 DSH 自带设置页：

```
拦截记录  v1.0.0                              [ 全部标为已办 ]  [ 清空记录 ]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  全部 12      待办 6      已办 3      跳过 3
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔍 搜索请求内容或会话 id                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
⊘ 帮我看看这个报错                    09:41   a1b2c3d4        [⊘]  [🗑]   ← 跳过：点一下恢复为待办
● 把 README 里的截图换掉              09:52   e5f6a7b8        [✓]  [🗑]
…（没有记录时是收件箱图标 +「暂无拦截记录」空态）
```

* **标签页**：全部 / 待办 / 已办 / **跳过**，各带实时计数；**搜索**匹配请求原文与会话 id
  （大小写不敏感），与标签页叠加生效。「待办」只算正常待办，被展示框收起过的那些归到「跳过」。
* **每行**：三态图标键（实心点 ↔ 对勾 ↔ 空心环 + 斜杠，同一套 SVG 与描边动画；**跳过态点一下
  即恢复为正常待办，单向**）、请求原文（截断）、时间、会话尾号、删除键。
  操作都是即时反馈，失败会在页面上写明错误码。
* **批量**：「全部标为已办」走 `POST /peak-guard/set` 的 `{checkAll:true}`（一条请求，不是 N 条）；
  「清空记录」是**两步确认**（第一次点变成「确认清空？」，再点才真删），避免误触。
* **一次拉全量**：`GET /peak-guard/state?limit=200`（卡片用默认 20 条，设置页要 200）；
  超过 200 条时页面顶上一行说明「只显示了最新的 200 条」。
* 这个页面只跟插件自己的两个路由打交道，**不读任何会话数据**。

> 💡 **提示：在设置里把「跳过」改回「待办」之后，对话界面那张卡片可能要等一会儿才会显示它。**
> 改动是立刻落盘的，设置页也会顺手把新状态推给两边共用的那份内存状态，所以切回对话界面
> **通常立刻就能看到**；万一那张卡片还是旧样子（比如两个窗口各开着一份），最多等 **20 秒** ——
> 卡片每 20 秒轮询一次，窗口重新获得焦点时也会立刻刷新。

> **为什么没有「一键补发 / 谷时自动补发」**：做过一版，投递链路脆弱（要跨会话 resume + 排队 +
> 串行等待，还容易和用户手上的回合并发）且语义上自相矛盾 —— 这个插件的意义是"高峰期别烧钱"，
> 而"谷时替你自动发一遍"是在你不在场时替你花钱。**已整体砍掉**，相关路由、命令、依赖
> （`sessionController`）、界面控件、配置键全部删除。插件现在只做一件事：**拦下 + 记账 + 让你看见**。
> 之前的设计推演留在 [`docs/DESIGN-replay-tradeoffs.md`](docs/DESIGN-replay-tradeoffs.md) 里当记录。

**几何是照官方那张卡片的 CSS 抄的**（`aSus8q_*` 那组规则：`width/max-width` 用
`--dsh-composer-card-max-width` 与 `--dsh-composer-*` 那套 composer 变量、`border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-lg)`、
`background: var(--dsw-specific-menu)`、`box-shadow: var(--dsw-elevation-panel)`、`__body` 内边距 `6px 12px`、
列表 `gap:8px / max-height:180px / item 行高 20px`），所以它跟输入框**同宽、同一水平中线**，
不会自己长出另一种宽度或节奏。折叠箭头是 SVG 描边图标（16px 画布 / 1.6px 描边 / 圆头圆角 `currentColor`），
不是 `^` `ˇ` 字符 —— 字符的字形和粗细随字体走，跟官方那枚对不上。

三个不写就会"看起来不对"的细节（都有测试盯着）：

* **表头那格灰色说明永远渲染**（没内容时是空元素）。它是 `flex:auto` 的弹簧 ——
  少了它，折叠箭头就会贴在标题后面，而不会靠右。
* **圆角胶囊/圆点必须 `corner-shape:round`**：DSH 全局把圆角做成了 superellipse，
  不自带这行的话角标和提示点会被渲染成方圆角（自带组件就是这么写的）。
实现上的三条自我约束（照 DSH 官方插件开发 skill 的硬规矩）：

* **不 import 任何 DSH 自带的客户端包**（连 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 都不许），UI 全手写；
* **样式只用主题令牌** `--dsw-alias-*`，浅色/深色自动跟随 —— `test/client.test.mjs` 里有自动检查：
  CSS 里出现任何非 `--dsw-alias-` 的变量、或硬编码颜色，测试就判失败；
* 装样式 / 起定时器 / 挂监听器全在 `ctx.effect` 里（factory 阶段零副作用），随插件卸载回收；
  插槽注册失败只打日志，绝不连累输入区。两块 UI 共用**一份**轮询，不各打各的请求。

## 2. 判定口径（不是拍脑袋定的）

| 规则 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 高峰窗口 | 本地（默认 `Asia/Shanghai`）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，半开区间 `[start, end)` |
| 周末 | 本地周六/周日**全天谷价** |
| 法定假期 | 默认内置 2026 年中秋 + 国庆共 10 天，全天谷价（每年需更新一次） |

这套口径与 `dsh-cost-meter` 的峰谷计价**逐项一致**（那边的窗口来自 DeepSeek 控制台公告
并跟随官方页面同步）。`test/peak.test.mjs` 里有一段差分测试：从 2026-08-22T16:00Z 到
2027-03-01、每 7 分钟采一个点，逐点比对本插件的 `isPeak` 与 `dsh-cost-meter` 的
`isPeakHour`，另有 60 天、每 53 分钟一次的「下一个切换点」比对。**两边有一个点不一致，
测试就红。**

## 3. 安装

```powershell
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1            # 装进 desktop（默认）
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1 -WhatIf    # 只看要做什么，不落盘
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1 -Uninstall # 卸载
```

脚本做四件事：备份 profile 的 `package.json` → 加一条 `link:` 依赖 → 把包名追加进
`dsh.profile.bundles` → 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建 junction。做完会自校验
（依赖 / bundles / 链接 / 入口可达），任一项不过就以非零码退出并告诉你怎么用备份还原。

> `desktop` 是 Electron 保留 profile，命令行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被
> 拒绝（"managed exclusively by the Electron application"），所以走脚本。

**生效方式（分两种，别混）**：

| 改了什么 | 怎么生效 |
|---|---|
| **profile 组合**（装/卸插件、`dsh.profile.bundles`、profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`） | **就地热生效**。本机实测：脚本写完 profile 不到一秒，`include:peak-guard` 就是 `enabled + active` |
| **插件自己的代码**（`lib/*.js`、`package.json` 里的 `dsh.client`） | **必须完全退出并重开 DSH Desktop**。宿主模块是启动时 import 的，客户端产物也在启动时扫描一次（`dsh-hmr` 只 watch 配置文件，不管模块代码）—— 实测：改完代码后新增的 HTTP 路由与 `/plugins/dsh-peak-guard/client.js` 都还是 404，重启后才出现 |

## 4. 逃生门

被锁在门外还进不去，那就不是插件是牢房。所以留了这些路，任何一条都能把人捞出来：

| 逃生门 | 怎么用 | 生效范围 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入框左边那个开关 | 点一下（走 `fetch`，**不需要模型参与**） | 立刻，且落盘 |
| `/peak enable｜disable` | 等价于上面那个开关 | 立刻，且落盘 |
| `/peak off [分钟]` | 临时放行（命令走 `commands` 服务，不需要模型） | 运行时，最长到重启 |
| `/peak force` / `/peak on` | 现场强制拦 / 立刻收回 | 运行时 |
| `allowSessions` | 配置里写 session id 白名单 | 直到改配置 |
| `DSH_PEAK_GUARD=off` | 启动 DSH 前设环境变量（`0/off/false/no/disable` 都算关） | 整进程，重启前一直有效 |

`/peak` 的全部子命令：

```
/peak                     看当前峰谷状态、窗口、拦截计数、话术与被拦截列表
/peak test                不下发请求，先看看提示语长什么样（dry-run）
/peak force [分钟]        无视峰谷强制拦一段时间（默认 5 分钟）—— 用来现场验收
/peak enable|disable      高峰保护总开关（和输入框左边那个开关同一个状态，会落盘）
/peak off [分钟|forever]  临时放行（默认 30 分钟；forever = 放行到重启）
/peak on                  立刻恢复拦截（同时收回 force / off）
/peak list                列出高峰期间被拦下的请求（只是记录，插件不会替它们重投）
```

## 5. 配置

配置在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`

plugins.description: Observe and steer a local Codex (OpenAI) session from DeepSeek Harness, over the codex app-server protocol.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-bridge

Observe and steer a local **Codex** (OpenAI) session from **DeepSeek Harness**.

The plugin talks to `codex app-server` — the same protocol the Codex app itself
uses — which is what makes the live parts possible at all:

| | Reading the rollout `.jsonl` | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transcript | after it is written | live deltas, plus polls |
| Reasoning | only what was flushed | summary deltas as they stream |
| Rate-limit budget | not present | `account/rateLimits/read` |
| Send a message | not possible | queue (the only cross-process path) |
| Answer an approval | not possible | only for turns this bridge started |

It was built as a DSH counterpart to a Codex session running in the Codex desktop
app: read what that session is doing, hand it the next instruction, and know
exactly which parts are impossible rather than guessing.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `codex_status` | Account, plan, rate-limit budget, local processes, latest thread, pending approvals. Degrades to a readable message when Codex is not reachable instead of throwing. |
| `codex_threads` | Recent threads, optionally filtered by a search string. |
| `codex_transcript` | Items of one thread, newest first. |
| `codex_watch` | Watches a thread for N seconds and returns what streamed past, merging the live notification stream with transcript polls and labelling each event's `source`. |
| `codex_send` | `queue` (default), `turn`, or `steer`. Falls back to the queue when the desktop app holds the thread's write lock. |
| `codex_approvals` | Lists pending approval requests and answers them. |
| `codex_queue` | Shows the messages still waiting on a thread (`action=list`), and cancels one with `action=delete`. Reports what the app-server confirmed, since a live session usually consumes a queued message first. |
| `codex_budget` | Reads the rate-limit buckets and says whether Codex is out of quota, quoting the server's own flags. A high `usedPercent` is a level, not a limit, so 100% is not reported as "out of quota". |
| `codex_ask` | One question on a throwaway Codex thread, with a chosen model and effort, then hands the answer back into a development thread verbatim (`feed:false` to only read it). It is the DSH↔Codex quick-chat path; a model override that Codex declines fails the call instead of quietly asking the default model. |
| `codex_handoff` | Builds a takeover brief out of the thread's own records — the objective, the instruction quoted verbatim, what it touched, where it stopped, the quota at that moment, and what the brief cannot know. `saveTo` writes it to a file. `action: "prepare"` writes it as a **takeover** of a thread whose quota is gone; `action: "claim"` records that a person or this session has actually taken it over. |

## Board

The same projection is also a panel inside Harness: a sidebar row named **Codex**
opens a board whose columns are **Needs you** (red), **Blocked** (orange),
**Running** (green) and **Nothing observed** (grey), in that order — the four
states live in `src/task-state.js`, one rule per state.

Every judgement is made on the host, in pure functions, so the panel cannot invent
a status the protocol never reported. Each card shows the state, whether it was
`reported` or `inferred`, the reasons behind it, the evidence it rests on, the
newest recorded turn statuses as a strip, and a progress bar **only when Codex
reported a denominator** (a goal's token budget, or plan steps). With no
denominator the card shows the counts it really has and says
`no progress denominator reported` instead of drawing a bar from nothing.

Six rules keep it honest:

- A thread holding an approval this connection is responsible for is **Needs you**,
  and it is never filed under Blocked even when it also has queued messages.
- *Running* means Codex reported the turn as advancing, **or** this bridge's
  connection saw `turn/started` and has not seen it finish, **or** the rollout was
  touched seconds ago — and that last case is printed as `inferred`. The fourth
  column is **Nothing observed**, never "idle": silence from a connection-scoped
  protocol is not proof that nothing is happening.
- Every card carries a **last** line: the newest item the rollout reports that is not
  encrypted reasoning, with that item's own status printed verbatim. It reports what
  the thread last did; it is not a claim that a turn is running.
- Age is part of the judgement, not decoration, and the age is the **turn's own
  end time** (`completedAt`), never when the thread was last touched — opening a
  thread, or restarting Codex, bumps `updatedAt` and would otherwise make a
  day-old failure look new. A failed turn is **Needs you** while it is fresh; on a
  thread with no goal, a failure older than `FAILURE_ATTENTION_MS` (48 hours)
  keeps its error text as evidence and the card settles to grey. The board's first live run was three red cards whose failures
  were seconds, 3.6 days and 12.8 days old, and only the first wanted anything —
  a red column that never empties is one people stop reading. The same failure on a
  thread that still carries a goal stays red at any age, because the goal is Codex's
  own standing statement about work that is meant to be running.
- Queue, item, turn and goal inspection are sampled (a bounded number of threads per
  refresh, all of it reported in the snapshot's `probe` block), and the board says so
  rather than presenting a partial read as a total.
- The account line and the quota line come from the same predicate as
  `codex_budget`, and a reached quota is a warning that quotes the server's flag.

### When Codex runs out: prepare, then claim

A reached quota is the one failure nothing here retries — it is not a run that
stopped, it is an account that ran out, and a red card that can never change is one
people stop reading. So a quota card offers **Prepare a takeover**: the plugin writes
the handoff brief to `<project>/.codex-handoff/<threadId>-<time>.md` and the card says
so.

**A prepared brief is not a handover, and the panel keeps saying so.** The plugin
cannot push into a Harness conversation, so `claimed` may only be set by an explicit
`codex_handoff action=claim` (or the card's **Mark taken over** button). Until then
the card reads *takeover prepared, unclaimed*, with that sentence attached. The
records live in memory for the run; the file is on disk for whoever looks next.

The panel's controls are almost all reads, and exactly one of them can reach Codex.
**Refresh** re-reads the snapshot. **Takeover brief** renders the same markdown
`codex_handoff` builds, with Copy and Close buttons. **Pause this thread** /
**Resume this thread** stops the autopilot from touching that one thread. **Prepare
a takeover** and **Mark taken over** drive the local takeover store — the first only
where a card is actually asking, the second only after the first. **Evaluate one
pass** runs a single autopilot pass through the same guards, so with the autopilot
off it writes nothing.

**Keep Codex moving for 30m** is the one that arms the autopilot. While armed, and
only then, a host-side timer may queue a continuation message into a **Blocked**
thread, or into a **Needs you** thread whose failure the supervisor can read as
transient, through `thread/queue/add` — the same single write `codex_send` uses.

### What it sends

Not a bare "continue". Every automatic message is a **supervision brief** built from
that thread's own record — and only from it: the goal objective Codex was given,
Codex's own last `agentMessage` word for word (with its phase), the newest turn's
status and, when it failed, the error text Codex recorded plus how long ago that was,
the item counts for the turn, and whether a queue is still unconsumed. Nothing is
paraphrased and nothing is invented; where the record is empty the brief says so
(`这个线程没有记录目标`, `没有留下可读的回复文字`).

### Resume, do not replay

Before a supervised message is sent, the thread's working directory is read with
`git status --porcelain` (read-only, 5s, never fatal). A resume is not a re-run: if
the directory already carries uncommitted work — or the failing turn recorded file

plugins.description: small session tabs plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop app
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-tabs

JetBrains-style session tabs for the DSH Web GUI: one tab per chat session, in a
strip at the top of the conversation panel.

![Switching between session tabs](docs/session-tabs.gif)

```
│ ● Add DeepSeek…  × │ ● Fix the login bug │ ● vendor sync │
```

A session you **sent a message in** keeps its tab. A session you merely
**opened** is one disposable tab that the next open replaces, so clicking
through the sidebar never leaves a trail of tabs.

## The rule

This is the editor-tab behaviour from JetBrains, with sessions in the role of
files:

| Session | Tab |
| --- | --- |
| You sent a message in it | An ordinary tab that stays |
| You only opened it | The single "preview" tab, replaced by the next open |

The stick signal is **not tracked by this plugin**. The session list already
carries it as `blank`:

> A blank session is the selected Workspace's provisional New Session row.

`blank === false` therefore means the session has real content. The host sets it
on the first accepted prompt (`promptAttempted`, set synchronously before the
first await) and its reducer deliberately refuses to re-blank a session
afterwards:

```js
handleBlank(blank) {
  if (blank === this.blankBit) return;
  if (blank && (this.promptAttempted || this.running)) return;  // sticky
  ...
}
```

So "sent a message" is the host's own durable notion of it, already computed and
already sticky. Delegating to it means the strip cannot disagree with the rest of
the UI about whether a session has been used, and there is no local bookkeeping
to drift or to persist.

Two properties follow, and both are tested:

- **Order is engagement order**, not recency. Revisiting an old tab does not
  reshuffle the strip under the pointer.
- **The preview is always last**, because it is the one that will be replaced.

Subagent sessions are excluded: they are reached through their parent's
breadcrumb rather than by switching the conversation, so a tab for one would
misrepresent what the strip does. Nothing is capped or recycled: every engaged
session keeps a tab in engagement order, and the row **scrolls sideways** when the
tabs outgrow it (plain wheel included), with the active tab kept in view.

## Placement — the first row of the conversation

The strip is **registered** in `conversation.input.dock` — a list seat above the
composer, shared with the todo, queue, and goal docks — and **drawn** in a row this
plugin anchors ahead of every row the conversation already has, so the tabs are the
first thing in the conversation:

```
div.root                            ← the conversation column (flex column)
├── div[data-session-tabs-host]     ← the strip's row (inserted by this plugin)
├── header                          ← title row + Chat/Trajectory view tabs
└── div[data-conversation-content]  ← transcript + composer
```

### Why it is not a seat

The app declares no seat above the conversation content:

- `conversation.header` is a **single** seat declared *and* occupied by the
  shipped `ui-conversation` plugin. A second registration at the same priority
  throws `single slot "conversation.header" already has a registration …`;
  registering at `apply` time — before the seat exists — throws
  `slot "conversation.header" is not declared`, which fails the plugin's whole
  fiber and aborts web boot.
- Its only unoccupied child, `conversation.header.leading`, sits *inside* the
  title bar (the window drag region), so it cannot hold a full-width row.
- The header's other children (`…session.header.actions`, `.utilities`) are narrow
  control clusters beside the title.

Placement is therefore done in the DOM: the dock registration supplies the seat
and the session props, and the component inserts a host row as the conversation
column's first child, then renders the strip into it with `createPortal` (the shell
exposes `react-dom` as a platform seed word, so a client bundle may require it).
The column is reached from the seat's own placeholder, so it is always the column
that seat belongs to. The host is re-anchored whenever it leaves the document, so a
re-render of the conversation column cannot strand the strip in a detached node.

The row sits outside the header's `data-window-drag` region, so chips click and
scroll normally; window dragging keeps the title row and the sidebar.

### Why the memory is the whole order, not the visible tabs

`stepTabs` returns the strip *and* the order to remember next, which is the full
engagement order — never the window that happened to be rendered. That looks like a
detail; it is the difference between a still strip and a rotating one:

| Remembered | What 6 re-renders of 10 engaged sessions show |
| --- | --- |
| the visible tabs (a window) | 5 distinct windows — the strip rotates on every re-render |
| the full engagement order | 1 window, unchanged |

Typing re-renders the strip constantly (the session store ticks), so a rotating
strip is exactly the flicker a user sees while typing. `verify.mjs` replays this
loop through `stepTabs` — the function the component calls — and fails if more than
one window appears.

### Why the memory is module state, not a ref

Switching sessions **remounts** the conversation Factory occurrence — its key carries
the session generation — so a ref dies the moment you open another session. A
dismissal kept in a ref therefore came back on the very next click elsewhere, and the
engagement order died with it, reshuffling the tabs on every switch. `dismissedTabs`
and `engagementOrder` are module state for that reason, and `verify.mjs` drives real
remounts (fresh refs, retained module memory) to assert both survive.

A page reload would still wipe them, and the shell reloads its page whenever the app
restarts, so the same memory is written to `localStorage` under
`dsh.session-tabs.v1` — the `dsh.<name>.v1` convention shipped client plugins use (the
conversation's transcript width, the right sidebar's layout) — and read back on load.
That key lives in the `dsh-app://app` origin, which the desktop registers as
`standard` + `secure`, so it survives restarts. A blocked store, a missing key, or a
corrupt payload all read as a cold start rather than an error, and the offline suite
covers the round trip, the payload validation, and a seeded "page load".



### The scrollbar is the shell's

The strip sets no `scrollbar-width`/`scrollbar-color`, on purpose. `ui-theme`
installs unscoped `::-webkit-scrollbar` rules (`--dsh-scrollbar-width` = 5px, a
rounded thumb in `--dsw-alias-scrollbar-bg-l1`, a hover colour from
`--dsw-alias-scrollbar-hover-l1`), so the bar matches the transcript's and the
sidebar's. Chromium **ignores** those rules for any element that sets the standard
properties, and the strip used to set `scrollbar-width: thin` — which is why it had a
fat native macOS bar while the rest of the app had a thin themed one. If a profile
disables `ui-theme`, the strip's bar goes native along with every other scrollbar.

### The frame is browser-style, and why the rail is paint

The strip is drawn as a browser tab strip rather than a row of chips: a bar a shade
off the pane's own surface, the tabs sitting on a hairline rail along its bottom,
and the active tab punched down to the pane colour so it reads as *connected* to the
row beneath it. The chip is 30px tall with 8px shoulders and square feet
(`borderRadius: "8px 8px 0 0"`) on a 36px bar.

Three things about how that is drawn are deliberate, and each was forced by how CSS
composites a scroller:

- **The bar's fill is a translucent neutral** (`rgba(127,127,127,0.12)`), not a
  surface token. The shell's surfaces are *raised above* the pane in dark mode —
  `--dsw-alias-bg-base` **is** the pane, and `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1…3` are lighter
  than it — so no single surface token can be "a bar slightly off the pane" in both
  themes: one theme would erase the bar, the other would paint a raised card. A 12%
  neutral over the pane reads as a raised bar in the dark theme and a recessed one
  in the light theme, from one value.
- **The active chip is filled with `--dsw-alias-bg-base`** — the pane's own colour.
  That, not a border or a shadow, is what merges the tab into the

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex / WorkBuddy 实时共享对话与关键操作：互相看见对方在同一个实验里做了什么，避免重复改文件 / 重复跑命令，并支持把某一方的活无缝接过来继续干。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-sync

> 让 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 与 **Codex**、**WorkBuddy** 互相看见对方在同一个实验里做了什么。

你在同时用好几个 coding agent 推进**同一批实验**时，真正的痛点不是"模型不够强"，
而是**上下文困在另一个窗口里**。这个插件解决这件事：三方共用一条事件总线，
彼此实时看见对方改了什么文件、跑了什么命令、得出什么结论，
并且可以把其中一方的活**无缝接过来继续干**。

三个 agent 在同一台机器、同一个工作目录里推进时，最容易出的问题是：
重复改同一个文件、重复跑同一条命令、基于过期的假设继续往下做。
这个插件把三方的**聊天记录 + 关键操作**汇到一条共享总线上，实时互相注入，并提供一个
动手前的「防重复闸门」；每个聊天还能独立开关同步。

> **这是 DSH 的树外插件**，走官方支持的扩展点安装，**不需要 fork 或修改 DSH 本体**。
> 属于 DSH 生态的 `dsh-plugin`。

---

## 它到底做了什么

| 能力 | 机制 |
|---|---|
| **实时同步 Codex / WorkBuddy 的聊天与操作** | 只读跟随 `~/.codex/sessions/**.jsonl` 与 `~/.workbuddy/projects/**/*.jsonl`，解析成统一事件，追加进共享总线 |
| **我能沿着它们的足迹回答你** | `agent_chat`：按参与方/时间/关键词/类别检索真实记录，而不是我猜 |
| **盯住某一条对话（分支旁路）** | `agent_target` 绑定一条外部会话；之后 `agent_chat(deep=true)` 直接深读该会话的**完整历史文件** |
| **接着它把活干完** | `agent_handoff` 生成交接简报：目标、已改动文件、命令与失败、最后一次结论、还没做完的点 |
| **它们能看见我的操作（双向）** | 我的工具调用、结论、命令、改动的文件自动写进总线；再物化成 `inbox/<agent>.md` 供 Codex / WorkBuddy 读取 |
| **实时注入，不用你复述** | `systemPrompt.context` 每步重算 → 对方的新动作直接出现在我当前上下文里；有新事件时额外 `agent.inject` 一条 notice |
| **防重复、防冲突** | `agent_write(action="check")`：改文件/跑命令前先问「别人是不是刚做过」，命中就报冲突 |
| **每个聊天独立可切换** | `sync_mode`：`off`（只留自己的记录）/ `read`（只看对方）/ `write`（只推自己）/ `both`（双向，默认） |

---

## 三种典型用法

### A. 分支旁路查询（主窗口不停）

Codex 在跑一个长实验，你在 DSH 这边问细节：

```
（你说）盯着 Codex 那个 Stage 1 的对话，它的接触窗口实验参数是怎么改的？
```

我会 `agent_target(action="bind")` 绑定那条会话 → `agent_chat(deep=true, query="...")` 深读完整
历史 → 给出带时间戳的真实记录。**Codex 那边的会话完全不受影响。**

### B. 接管它剩下的活

```
（你说）Codex 太慢了，你接着把它剩下的活干完。
```

我会 `agent_handoff` 生成交接简报（目标 / 33 个已改动文件 / 106 条命令与退出码 /
未完成信号），据此继续执行。想让接手过程不占用主窗口，就把简报交给 `subagent` 去跑。

### C. 防止两边重复动手

动手前我会 `agent_write(action="check", paths=[...])`：
若 Codex 30 分钟内改过同一文件、或跑过同一条命令，它会直接报冲突，我据此避让。

---

## 三方格式（已实测）

| Agent | 会话文件 | 方言 |
|---|---|---|
| Codex | `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl` | `session_meta` / `response_item`(message, function_call, function_call_output) / `event_msg` / `token_usage_record` |
| WorkBuddy | `~/.workbuddy/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl` | `session-meta` / `message` / `function_call` / `function_call_result` / `file-history-snapshot` / `ai-title`（Claude Code 风格） |
| DSH | `~/.dsh/sessions/<slug>/session-*.jsonl.zstd` | 由本插件挂 Host 事件实时转写，不解析自己的日志文件 |

Codex 与 WorkBuddy 都是 Codex/Claude 系分支，但 JSONL 结构不同，所以各有独立解析器。

---

## 前置条件

- **DeepSeek Harness**（[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)）。
  本插件是 DSH 的树外插件（out-of-tree plugin），走官方支持的 `cordis.patch.yml` 扩展点，
  **不需要 fork或修改 DSH 本体**。
- Node.js ≥ 22.15（内置 zlib zstd 支持；Node 24 已在 Windows / macOS / Linux 验证）。
- 本机已存在至少一个 Codex 或 WorkBuddy 的本地会话记录（否则插件能加载，但没有可同步的内容）。

>⚠️ **DSH 目前是 developer preview，官方明确会有 breaking changes。**
> 本插件依赖若干尚未稳定的内部契约（见文末「宿主契约」一节），
> DSH 升级后可能需要跟着调整。遇到问题请开 issue，附上 `~/.dsh/agent-sync/boot.json` 内容。

## 安装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dcsnkj/dsh-agent-sync.git
```

1. **链接到 profile 的共享依赖目录**（desktop / web 都用这一个），把 `<PLUGIN_DIR>` 换成你的 clone 路径：

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@local\dsh-agent-sync" `
     -Target "<PLUGIN_DIR>"
   ```

2. **在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加**（desktop profile 的路径是
   `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: agent-sync
         name: "@local/dsh-agent-sync"
         config:
           participants:
             - codex
             - workbuddy
           defaultMode: both
           pollMs: 1500
           watch: true
   ```

3. **重启 DSH**（profile 配置在启动时读取；本插件不依赖运行时 HMR）。

**验证是否装好**：

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\agent-sync\boot.json"
```

最后一个阶段应是 `"ready"`、`state` 为 `running`，且同目录下**没有** `last-error.json`。

<details>
<summary>跑测试（可选）</summary>

工程自带的 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*` 通常是指向 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`
的 junction，好让测试能解析真实依赖。若缺失：

```powershell
cd <PLUGIN_DIR>
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-tools `
  -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-tools"
node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
```

</details>

---

## 配置项

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `baseDir` | `~/.dsh/agent-sync` | 同步根目录（总线、状态、收件箱、hooks 都在这里） |
| `participants` | `[codex, workbuddy]` | 参与同步的其它 agent |
| `defaultMode` | `both` | 新聊天的默认同步模式 |
| `pollMs` | `1500` | 采集轮询间隔 |
| `recentWindowMs` | `3600000` | 注入时回看多久内的对方动作 |
| `pushMs` | `5000` | 收件箱刷新间隔 |
| `watch` | `true` | 关掉后只保留显式工具能力，不采集 |

---

## 模型可用的六个工具

- **`agent_target`** — 把本聊天绑定到某条外部会话（`list` / `bind` / `unbind` / `current`）。绑定后其余工具默认针对它。
- **`agent_chat`** — 检索三方的聊天与操作。`deep=true` 时直接深读目标会话的完整历史文件（不只是总线尾部）；支持 `fileTarget` 临时换目标、`query` / `kinds` / `keyOnly` / `sinceMinutes`。
- **`agent_handoff`** — 生成「接着干」的交接简报（目标 / 已改动文件 / 命令与失败 / 结论 / 未完成信号），可 `checkDisk` 核对文件是否真的还在。
- **`agent_watch`** — 对方最近在干嘛、有没有你还没看过的新动作、采集器与自诊断健康度。
- **`agent_write`** — `check`（动手前查冲突）/ `note`（登记结论）/ `claim`（登记即将执行的操作）。
- **`sync_mode`** — 切换本聊天的同步模式与参与方。

用户在对话里说「盯着 Codex 那个对话」「它太慢了接着干」「这个聊天不要同步了」，
模型会调用对应工具落实，无需手工改配置。

### 自诊断

`agent_watch` 的 `sources.selflog` 会报告：本插件累计看到多少 session 事件、写出多少条、
被模式/类别过滤掉多少、最后一条事件类型、订阅到几个 agent、以及最近的错误。
写回不生效时，先看这里区分「订阅没生效」和「没有操作可记」。

DSH 侧另有 5 分钟一次的心跳（`agent/pre-step` 触发，不经任何过滤），
用于让 Codex / WorkBuddy 知道 DSH 在线，同时作为订阅健康度的探针。

---

## 让 Codex / WorkBuddy 也能看到 DSH 的操作

我方操作会持续写入 `~/.dsh/agent-sync/inbox/codex.md` 与 `inbox/workbuddy.md`。

**方式一（零配置）**：在 Codex / WorkBuddy 里说

> 读 ~/.dsh/agent-sync/inbox/codex.md，看 DeepSeek Harness 最近做了什么，再继续我的实验。

**方式二（hook 自动带上）**：`~/.dsh/agent-sync/hooks/` 下已生成 `read-inbox.ps1` / `read-inbox.sh`，
把它们挂到对方的 hooks 配置（如 Codex 的 `~/.codex/hooks.json`）即可。详见该目录的 `README.md`。

> 我方无法改写对方的 prompt 组装，所以采用「共享收件箱 + 对方读取」的方式；
> 这是唯一不需要修改对方程序就能双向同步的做法。

---

## 数据与隐私

这个插件会**读取你本机其他 AI 助手的会话记录**，所以有必要说清楚它碰了什么。

**它会读：**

- `~/.codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl`（或 `.jsonl.zst`）—— 只读，解析成统一事件
- `~/.workbuddy/projects/**/*.jsonl` —— 同上
- `~/.dsh/` 下自己的同步目录

**它绝不会做：**

- **不修改** `~/.codex` 与 `~/.workbuddy` 下的任何内容（全程只读打开）
- **不读取** `~/.codex/auth*.json`、`config.toml` 等凭据文件
- **不上报**任何数据 —— 没有任何网络请求，全部数据留在本机

**它会写（都在自己的目录里）：**

- 总线：`~/.dsh/agent-sync/events.ndjson`（追加式，按 `participant+sessionId+sourceId` 去重）
- 状态：`state.json`（每个聊天的同步开关）、`cursors.json`（每个 reader 的已读位置）
- 收件箱：`inbox/<agent>.md` —— 供 Codex / WorkBuddy 反向读取 DSH 的操作

**解析时主动丢弃的内容：**

- `base_instructions`、`developer` / `system` 角色的消息、`world_state`
- token 记录只保留数字字段，不保留正文
- 永远不会把密钥/令牌写进总线

> 想彻底关掉某个聊天的同步：在该聊天里调用 `sync_mode(mode="off")`。
> 想彻底停用插件：注释掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那段并重启 DSH。

前置：把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 等 peer 依赖链进 `node_modules`（或直接用

```powershell

node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"

# 插件在「Host 等价环境」里真实执行 apply()（会注册工具并调用一次 agent_chat）
node test\apply-smoke.mjs "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"

# 真实文件端到端：跟随活跃 Codex 会话并检索

  parsers/

    workbuddy.js   WorkBuddy 项目会话解析器
  watch.js         增量跟随 + 活跃会话发现

## 排查：插件没生效时按这个顺序看

**1. 确认 Loader 里这个条目是什么状态**（最直接）

```
plugin_manager(action="list_plugins", offset=150, limit=50)
```

看 `include:agent-sync`：
- `fiberPhase: "active"` → 已加载成功
- `fiberPhase: "failed"` → 加载了但初始化抛异常，看下一步
- 条目根本不存在 → `cordis.patch.yml` 的 patch 没被采纳（检查 `- insert:` 的位置与 YAML）

**2. 看落地自诊断文件**

桌面端看不到 Host 的 console 输出，所以插件把关键阶段直接写进文件：

```
~/.dsh/agent-sync/boot.json        每次 apply 都写；stages 记录走到了哪一步
~/.dsh/agent-sync/last-error.json  任何异常都会写：where / message / stack / 已完成的 stages
```

`boot.json` 最后一条 stage 就是成功到达的位置。若 `last-error.json` 存在，
其 `where` 字段直接指出失败阶段（`apply-sync` 同步期 / `async-init` 异步初始化期）。

**3. 看写回是否生效**（总线里 `dsh` 事件为 0 就是没生效）
